Elisha and the widows oil, second Kings 4. A woman who owed money told the man of God her trouble, and Elisha said borrow not a few empty vessels, and pour from what you have, small as it is. The oil did not run out while there were still jars to fill. It was God showing He can make something small enough for a family to live. When you only have a little, bring it to God in prayer and do the next right thing. He is not out of help.
